channel_type.description: Type of conversation the message was posted in

team_id.description: ID of the workspace the event happened in

api_app_id.description: ID of the Slack app the event was sent to

event_time.description: When the event was dispatched, in Unix seconds

thread.description: Computed by the platform, not sent by Slack: event.thread_ts for a thread reply, else event.ts. Identifies the thread within its channel

user.description: ID of the user who sent the message

thread_ts.description: Timestamp ID of the thread's parent message, set on thread messages

channel.description: ID of the channel the message was posted in
